hero.description: We're on a mission to help 100 million kids fall in love with learning through play-based education

mission.desc: Little Champ is a leading educational technology platform that transforms how children learn. With over 500+ interactive games covering Math, Reading, and Craft & Drawing for Pre-K through Grade 7, we make learning feel like play while delivering curriculum-aligned content that builds essential skills.

pillars.intro: Little Champ is a child-focused development center dedicated to nurturing young minds through innovation, creativity, and expert guidance. We believe every child grows best in a supportive, engaging, and inspiring environment.

card1.desc: At Little Champ, we introduce AI-assisted learning in a child-friendly way to build curiosity and smart thinking.
card1.item1: AI as a learning companion and interactive friend
card1.item2: Improving general knowledge and academic learning
card1.item4: Developing positive behavior and emotional growth

card2.desc: Learning becomes powerful when it is fun and engaging. We provide:
card2.item1: Brain-boosting games to improve focus and logical thinking
card2.item2: Mind activity sessions for memory and problem-solving
card2.item4: Craft activities to develop fine motor skills and imagination
card2.highlight: Enjoy learning while building life skills

card3.desc: We care about complete child development. That's why we include:
card3.item1: Interactive sessions with experienced pediatric doctors
card3.item4: Expert advice on healthy physical, mental, and emotional growth
card3.highlight: Supporting every step of your child's growth

closing.textEnd: to build confident, intelligent, and happy children.
closing.tagline: Growing Young Minds for a Brighter Future

howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account in seconds. All payments required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Select from Pre-K to Grade 7. Pick subjects that interest your child.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Kids explore 500+ games. AI adapts difficulty to their level.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Parents & teachers get real-time insights on learning growth.

testimonials.desc: Discover how Little Champ is transforming learning for millions of families worldwide. Real stories from real parents about their children's progress.
testimonials.t1Text: My 7-year-old used to struggle with math, but since using Mind Jr, she's excited to practice every day. The games make learning fun and she's already ahead of her grade level!
testimonials.t2Text: As a homeschool parent, Mind Jr has been a game-changer. The curriculum-aligned content covers all subjects and my kids are learning while having fun. Worth every penny!
testimonials.t3Text: I use Mind Jr in my classroom and the kids absolutely love it. The progress tracking helps me identify areas where students need extra support. Highly recommend!
